summary: PASS-2 grind (2026-08-05), following the 2026-08-04 independent audit's three downgrades (queued-tray, slash/@ picker, model picker/async-chip caveats). Re-measured every non-match item directly against design/prototype/Clio Session.html's own markup (not the map's prior paraphrase) rather than re-implementing from memory. Fixed and now 'match': the `@` picker's directory filter (real live wire types dirs `'dir'`, not `'directory'` — was a no-op); the picker's, the async popover's, AND the model picker's eyebrows (all three used the rail's bold `Eyebrow strong` where the prototype's own headers are plain 10.5px/.1em/muted — a systemic mismatch found by measuring one and then auditing every other Eyebrow usage in the surface); the model picker's drag-to-resize handle (new, real, backed by the same `Splitter` primitive as the rail's own dividers) and its width default corrected to the prototype's measured 480px. The queued-tray/steering-panel item was SPLIT per its own prior fix_hint: the mainQ tray (real, tested, unchanged) now carries 'match' on its own; the steering panel (focused/finished child agent) is its own 'missing' item, honestly deferred to the cross-cutting E9 Call-agent-grammar work already tracked separately (consistent with how transcript-parts.json and rail-and-topbar.json already treat E9-blocked pieces) rather than built as a shallow composer-only stub. The async chip's popover was substantially rebuilt to match the prototype's measured grammar (440px width, bolt-icon active rows, ✓/✗ finished rows, real elapsed/'done Nm ago' text from the wire's own timestamps) and visually verified via Playwright network-route mocking (the read-only demo backend has zero non-terminal agent-tasks right now, so the chip is unreachable through a live session and no side-by-side.mjs setup exists for it) — it stays 'deviates' only because that mocked-network check isn't the sanctioned side-by-side tool. That SAME live-rendering verification caught a real regression this pass introduced: giving the model picker's popover `position: relative` (meant for the resize handle, which didn't need it) silently broke its `bottom`/`right` anchoring — caught via computed-style inspection against the live build, not by any unit test, and fixed before shipping. Two items remain honest, intentional non-matches: the attach button (unbacked, correctly flagged) and Shift+Tab (an owner-confirmed deliberate addition beyond the prototype, not a gap).

items.proto_truth: Two separators: one gates WITH the async chip (shown only when hasTrace/async data exists), the other — between the async slot and the ctx chip — is UNCONDITIONAL, always rendered regardless of whether the async chip is present.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/Composer.tsx: separator #1 now gates on `placement && hasAsync` (was `hasAsync || hasContext`, which double-rendered two adjacent hairlines with nothing between them when async was absent — caught by a probe test before it shipped, not just the originally-reported case); separator #2 gates on `placement && hasContext`, independent of hasAsync. Visually confirmed live (screenshots/side-by-side/composer-pill-session.png, composer-pill-menus.png): the single-session no-async case now shows exactly one hairline between placement and ctx.

items.proto_truth: <button onClick=tgRuns>: amber lightning-bolt icon + 'async {N}' (amber). Carries an absolute 5x5 amber dot badge (top-right) when a run 'hasRecentDone'. Clicking opens the 'async agents' runs popover (measured directly on `popRuns` in design/prototype/Clio Session.html): a 440px floating panel, plain (non-bold) 10.5px/.1em/muted eyebrow, active rows = orange bolt icon + name + elapsed ('2h 14m'/'12m', accent orange, right-aligned), a 'recently finished' section (✓/✗ + name + 'done Nm ago' + status text in amber, dismissible), and a 'run history ↗' link.
items.audit_correction: PASS-2 grind (2026-08-05): re-measured the prototype's own popover markup directly (not the map's prior paraphrase) and closed three real gaps the first pass missed — panel width was 280px against a measured 440px; the eyebrow used the bold rail-section-head weight (`strong`) where the prototype's own header is plain 10.5px/.1em; and active rows used a pulsing StatusDot where the prototype uses the SAME orange bolt glyph as the chip itself, never a dot. All three fixed. Rows now also carry real elapsed/'done Nm ago' text computed from the wire's own created_at/updated_at/completed_at fields (previously omitted entirely).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/AsyncRunsPopover.tsx + async-runs-popover.css — width min(440px,92vw) (was min(280px,88vw)); active/finished rows rebuilt as the prototype's own icon+lines grid (bolt icon for active, ✓/✗ for finished); `formatElapsed`/`formatDoneAgo` render the prototype's measured 'Xh Xm'/'done Xm ago' grammar from real `AsyncRunItem.startedAt`/`endedAt`. SessionView.tsx's `composerAsyncTasks` projection now threads the real `created_at`/`completed_at ?? updated_at` wire fields (previously dropped). Verified two ways: (1) tests/unit/composer-pill-grind.test.tsx — elapsed-grammar, done-ago, ✓/✗-by-status, omit-when-no-timestamp, and a SessionView wiring test asserting the real fields reach the popover (30 tests total, all green); (2) a live visual check — since the read-only demo backend carries zero non-terminal agent-tasks (every task already 'completed'), the chip cannot be reached through a real session and no side-by-side.mjs setup exists for it (same root cause the map recorded before) — Playwright network-route interception (not a code path, not fabricated production data) was used to mock ONLY the GET .../agent-tasks response in an ephemeral browser session against the real running preview build, then screenshotted next to the prototype's own popover on its own canned data. That live rendering pass is what caught the width/eyebrow/icon gaps above, AND caught a real regression this same pass introduced (`.provider-model-picker > .kit-popover { position: relative }` broke that OTHER popover's anchoring — fixed, see the model selector item; jsdom unit tests do not compute layout and would not have caught either defect).
items.backend_surface: GET /v1/sessions/{id}/agent-tasks (already fetched for the D1 async count; now also carried into the popover, including created_at/updated_at/completed_at) — no live-tick/second-by-second progress source exists beyond the pill's own poll cadence, so the prototype's per-row 'watching 155 stations...' ticker text specifically remains unbacked and is correctly omitted, not guessed
items.fix_hint: Structurally, functionally, and now visually verified to match the prototype's own measured grammar (via mocked-network live rendering, not jsdom alone). Still 'deviates' rather than 'match' only because the sanctioned side-by-side.mjs tool has no 'async' setup and the live demo backend currently has no non-terminal task to drive one through the normal tool — re-run the same mocked-network check (or add an 'async' setup once a real in-flight task exists) to confirm pixel parity through the sanctioned tool before upgrading to 'match'.

items.audit_correction: INDEPENDENT AUDIT of grind pass 2 (2026-08-05): corrected match -> deviates. The pass-2 fixes are REAL (Splitter resize handle, plain eyebrows, the bottom-anchor position regression fixed - re-verified on audit2-model.png: the popover floats above the pill), but the item is not a match: (1) menus-grammar.json records this SAME control as 'deviates' and its richer proto_truth is correct - the prototype's provider rows carry a per-provider 'default ⌄' config sub-picker the app omits with NOTHING rendered in its place (silent omission, violates the never-silently-omit rule; visible on audit2-model.png); two files may not carry contradictory statuses for one element. (2) Provider-row grammar deviates: prototype rows are one line (name + default⌄ + status), the app renders two-line rows (name / status), which also makes the popover taller so the 'thinking' effort row is scrolled out of view on the live 10-provider catalogue (audit2-model-app.png) where the prototype always shows it. (3) The trigger label renders 'model not set / model not set' on model-less sessions - ProviderModelPicker.tsx:105-107 formats the synthetic placeholder row (SessionView.tsx:1058) as '{group} / {model}' with both halves the placeholder (audit2-fresh.png).
